name: @apries/sightline
description: Agent-first macOS screenshot CLI with target-based window discovery.

scripts.build: bun run build:helper && bun build src/cli.ts --target bun --outfile dist/sightline.js
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run src/cli.ts --version && bun run src/cli.ts doctor --json && bun run src/cli.ts list displays --json
scripts.check:package: bun run build && bun run src/cli.ts --version && npm pack --dry-run
